name: ddot.it (injection)
_comment: D1/D9: ddot.it as a GUEST language inside a host (Markdown, AsciiDoc, ...).
There is no magic-marker or fenced-block precondition -- the line-shape gate in
source.ddot decides, line by line, what is ddot.it. The selector below offers the
rules broadly to text/source documents while staying out of the host's own
comments and strings, where a stray '..' is never ddot.it.
'L:' makes the injection run BEFORE the host's own patterns, so a ddot.it triple
wins over host markup on the same line. Drop the 'L:' to let the host win instead.
NOTE: an excluded (!!off..!!on) span stops ddot.it's own rules but does not silence
the host tokeniser, which keeps colouring its syntax underneath.
